claim: In the current Kandy Esala Perahera ritual structure, Kataragama Devalaya is one of the four principal devalayas, alongside Natha, Vishnu and Pattini, that begin internal processions after the Kap-planting ritual.
bounded_by: Current institutional ritual organization only; this does not establish unchanged composition of the Perahera across earlier centuries or a single doctrinal interpretation of Kataragama.
notes: Created to give the Kataragama–Nallur bridge a first-party Kandy endpoint rather than inferring from generic Perahera tradition.
